definitions.explanation: The line on the scalp where the hair is divided and combed to either side.
The point at which things divide, and especially the decisive point on which an outcome turns, as in {天下|てんか}{分|わ}け{目|め}.

examples.japanese: {分|わ}け{目|め}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{変|か}えた→変える：01089_kaeru⟧。
{分|わ}け{目|め}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{右|みぎ}→右：02257_migi⟧にして⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧。
examples.english: I part my hair on the right.

examples.japanese: ⟦いつも→いつも：00599_itsumo⟧⟦{同|おな}じ→同じ：02857_onaji⟧⟦ところ→ところ：01137_tokoro⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{分|わ}けている→分ける：02333_wakeru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧、{分|わ}け{目|め}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{薄|うす}く→薄い：00764_usui⟧⟦{見|み}えて→見える：01165_mieru⟧くるそうだ。
examples.english: They say that if you always part your hair in the same place, the parting starts to look thin.

examples.japanese: ⟦ここ→ここ：00961_koko⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{勝負|しょうぶ}→勝負：01437_shoubu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{分|わ}け{目|め}だ。
examples.english: This is where the match will be decided.

examples.japanese: ⟦{関ヶ原|せきがはら}→関ヶ原：30770_sekigahara⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{戦|たたか}い→戦い：02070_tatakai⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{天下|てんか}{分|わ}け{目|め}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{戦|たたか}い→戦い：02070_tatakai⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{呼|よ}ばれる→呼ぶ：00766_yobu⟧。
examples.english: The Battle of Sekigahara is called the battle that decided the realm.

examples.japanese: ⟦{最初|さいしょ}→最初：00882_saisho⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{三か月|さんかげつ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{新|あたら}しい→新しい：00506_atarashii⟧⟦{事業|じぎょう}→事業：11421_jigyou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{成否|せいひ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{分|わ}け{目|め}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧だろう。
examples.english: The first three months will probably decide whether the new business succeeds or fails.

notes:
COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {分|わ}け{目|め}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{変|か}える→変える：01089_kaeru⟧: to change one's parting
- {七三|しちさん}{分|わ}け: a side parting (seven to three)
- ⟦{真|ま}ん{中|なか}→真ん中：00968_mannaka⟧{分|わ}け / ⟦センター→センター：03854_sentaa⟧{分|わ}け: a centre parting
- {天下|てんか}{分|わ}け{目|め}: the decisive moment (literally, the point that decides the realm)
- ⟦{勝負|しょうぶ}→勝負：01437_shoubu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{分|わ}け{目|め}: the turning point of a contest

USAGE:
Sense 2 almost always appears as the second half of a phrase (X⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{分|わ}け{目|め}); {天下|てんか}{分|わ}け{目|め} recalls the Battle of ⟦{関ヶ原|せきがはら}→関ヶ原：30770_sekigahara⟧ (1600) and is used for any showdown.
